body.contents: Would you like a tutorial? (Well right now, more like a brief info dump).
To access all menus in this datapack, use /trigger easy-anim
From the overworld, you will get a main menu. This will allow you to create, edit, render, and delete animations.
From the editor, you will get the editor menu. this will allow you to select frames, which are needed to then use operations on them like saving, loading, moving, etc.
If you find a bug, use /dialog show @s easy-anim:view_debug to check for any errors, and use /scoreboard players set #debug easy-anim 3 to turn on verbose logging.
Remember to save all your frames before exiting and yell at me in Discord if you find any bugs! (You will...)
If you need to see this message again, run /scoreboard players set @s easy-anim-first-time 0
